title: BRIDGE-AI Smart Agriculture Innovation Hackathon 2026
description: A three-day innovation hackathon bringing together students, software developers, researchers, entrepreneurs, and agricultural experts to design AI-powered solutions for sustainable agriculture. Participants will develop prototypes focused on smart mushroom farming, IoT monitoring, precision agriculture, computer vision, and data-driven farm management. Teams will receive mentorship from BRIDGE-AI consortium members and industry experts, with the opportunity to showcase their solutions during the final pitch competition.
location: JKUAT Smart Farm Zone, Juja, Kenya
